title: Staff Architect
description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them.

**The Role**

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns.

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Internal AI Engineering Platform**

* Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together.
* Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response.
* Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform.
* Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry.
* Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code.

**Client-Facing Product Architecture**

* Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features.
* Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns.
* Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved.
* Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable.
* Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation.
* Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency.
* Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review.
* Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms.

**Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars**

* Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization.
* Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them.
* Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure.
* Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context.

**Essential Criteria**

* 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently.
* Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience.
* Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability.
* Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary.
* Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five-line summary that aligns an executive.
* A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems.
* **Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use**
  .
* Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production.
* Experience designing for compliance, audit and regulatory requirements in financial services, healthcare or another regulated, data-sensitive domain.
* **Familiarity with cloud-native architecture on AWS (or equivalent), containerization, IaC and modern CI/CD.**
* A track record of writing or speaking publicly about software architecture or AI engineering practice.

**What We Offer**

* A senior technical leadership role with scope across both the AI platform that internal teams build on and the products our customers rely on.
* The chance to help define the architectural standards and patterns that hundreds of engineers and product managers will use every day.
* A collaborative, forward-thinking team that takes both engineering rigor and emerging AI practice seriously.
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of regulated financial data and modern AI tooling, where the technical bar and the business stakes are both high.

description:

**Business Consulting QAS- Quantitative Trading Book (QTB)**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front to back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with capital markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across global banks, broker dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of statistical and numerical techniques (e.g., Monte Carlo, finite difference methods)
* Knowledge of derivative pricing concepts across asset classes (rates, equities, credit, FX, commodities)
* Solid grounding in mathematical foundations including stochastic calculus, differential and integral calculus, probability, linear algebra
* Understanding of optimization techniques (e.g., gradient‑based methods) relevant to calibration, risk analytics, and numerical model implementation.
* Experience in model development, validation, monitoring, and audit procedures (stress testing, back testing, benchmarking) of trading book models.
* Strong coding skills in advanced Python / C++ and basic SQL
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation.
* Excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills.

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Exposure to market risk and counterparty credit risk methodologies (VaR, ES, SVaR, CVA, PFE) and time series techniques (e.g. GARCH).
* Hands on experience with pricing model development/validation (e.g., HW1F/2F, HJM, LMM, SABR, Heston, Dupire), volatility calibration, curve bootstrapping.
* Experience with risk/pricing systems such as Murex, Calypso, Numerix, Bloomberg, Calypso, SunGard Adaptiv, RiskMetrics, etc.

**What We Look For**

* Undergraduate or graduate degree in quantitative disciplines (Comp. Finance, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, Physics) or PhD in quantitative topics
* Regulatory knowledge in FRTB Basel, CCAR
* Professional certifications (CQF, FRM, PRM, RAI are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.

description:

**SUMMARY: Utilize standard and/or sponsor custom dictionaries to code Adverse Events, Medical and Surgical Histories, Medications and any other sponsor requested medical terminology required for projects. Ensure coding guidelines and company SOP’s are adhered to and dictionary versions / updates are maintained as appropriate for the project. Back up to Manager Clinical Coding and Data Management as required.**
**Responsibilities**
Tasks may include but are not limited to:
  
  

* As a priority, provide coding support for projects including:

+ Coding activities for Study start up on existing and new EDC databases
+ Input into the Data Management Plan, performing User Acceptance Testing, including review of Database Specifications and CRFs
+ Performing manual coding of medical and medication terms, generation and review of coding consistency reports for accuracy and submission of coding reports to internal Medical Monitor / peer review and for sponsor review at periodic time points specified for the project.

* Coordinate dictionary implementation and version updates for projects as applicable.
* Communicate effectively with Sponsors on general and project specific coding issues, as needed.
* Ensure coding is performed and delivered consistently both internally and externally with the highest quality and timelines are met according to study requirements.
* Coordinate dictionary licence validation checks and Worldwide licence renewal process.
* Identify coding process and technology improvements, implement changes, monitor the outcome and recommend further action.
* Provide leadership/mentorship to support junior staff performing coding activities.
* Attend sponsor and team meeting as necessary.
* Maintain solid awareness of study coding budget and potential CIS/OOS issues related to coding for studies.
* Provide regular updates to management regarding coding deliverables, metrics, coding issues, etc. as necessary.
* Ensure clinical coding operations are conducted according to WCT SOP’s.
* Act as back up to Manager Clinical Coding and Data Management as required.
* Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

**Other Skills And Abilities**

* Must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems. It is essential that the job holder works with close attention to detail and to be questioning about the validity of the data being entered.
* Excellent time management and man management skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple coding tasks and to prioritize workload accordingly with attention to detail.
* Very good interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to operate effectively in a global work environment.

**Requirements**

* Educated to degree level (preferably Life Science), Nursing qualification, or relevant industry experience Trained/experienced in coding with industry standard dictionaries (e.g., MedDRA, WHO-DD)
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in clinical data coding or a related role within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or medical device industries.

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

title: Test Engineer - SQL, ETL & Data Validation
description:
**Job Overview**
The individual is responsible for maintaining database objects, ETL processes, reports, and backend components while ensuring the quality, accuracy, and reliability of applications and data platforms. The role includes participating in requirements analysis, solution design, coding, unit testing, database validation, ETL testing, defect resolution, and production support activities. The individual will work closely with business analysts, developers, DBAs, and stakeholders to deliver scalable and high-quality data solutions.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Carries out procedures to ensure that all information systems products and services meet minimum organization standards and end-user requirements.
* Writes test plans and detailed test scripts supporting test cases derived from an analysis of functional requirements and programming specifications, perform unit, functional, integration, system, regression, user acceptance, backend, database, and data validation testing to ensure quality and reliability of applications and data solutions.
* Thoroughly tests software to ensure proper operation and freedom from defects prior to implementation.
* Documents and works to resolve all problems.
* Devises improvements to current procedures and develops models of possible future configurations.
* Performs work flow analysis and recommends quality improvements.
* Establishes software quality standards for life cycle, documentation, development methods, testing and maintenance.
* Establishes advanced software test standards and methods and conducts complex software tests.
* Analyze business, functional, and technical requirements; participate in solution design; enhance, maintain, and validate SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, reports, data extracts, and other database objects to support business and reporting requirements.
* Design, support, execute, and validate ETL processes, database solutions, and data workflows, ensuring accurate data movement, transformation logic, business rule compliance, data integrity, and operational stability across source and target systems.
* Conduct data reconciliation, source-to-target validation, data quality analysis, and report verification to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with business requirements.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, test, and validate SQL jobs, batch processes, applications, databases, ETL workflows, and production releases; identify issues, implement fixes, and recommend performance and reliability improvements.
* Identify, document, track, and verify defects; participate in root cause analysis, defect triage, peer reviews, and resolution activities while ensuring adherence to development standards and quality expectations.
* Collaborate with developers, QAs, DBAs, business analysts, and stakeholders to review requirements and technical specifications, deliver scalable and high-quality solutions, communicate status and quality metrics, and support deployments, release validation, production verification, and post-release testing.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by enhancing practices, testing processes, test coverage, automation opportunities, and overall solution quality, while performing additional responsibilities assigned by management.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  
  
2-4 years of experience in validating data-centric applications.
  
  
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server and complex SQL query development.
  
  
Experience developing and testing stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, and database jobs.
  
  
Experience working with ETL processes and data integration solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of database design principles, data validation, and data quality concepts.
  
  
Experience validating data transformations, mappings, and source-to-target reconciliations.
  
  
Familiarity with reporting solutions and report validation techniques.

title: Power BI and Executive Insights Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 Team \- EY Strategy Execution \& Operations (SE\&O)
   

  

 Stakeholder(s) \- C\&I Executive Insights Command Centre
   

  

 Role Title(s) \- Power BI \& Executive Insights Lead
   

  

 SE\&O Competency Pillar \- SEO Region Support USLI
   

  

**The Role**
 The Strategy \& Value Insights Lead is responsible for enabling business leaders understand markets performance along with key drivers with actionable and impactful insights. This professional needs to be able to examine data, derive patterns, infer insights in the lens of business context and generate easy to understand business narratives.
   

  

 The Power BI \& Executive Insights Lead will design, develop and maintain executive reporting solutions, dashboards and analytical products for USLI leadership. The role combines Power BI development, data modelling and visualization with business analytics to transform Markets and performance data into clear, actionable executive insights. The successful candidate will understand the EY reporting environment and collaborate with business stakeholders, data owners and Global Analytics teams to deliver trusted, scalable and decision\-ready reporting.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Dashboard Development \& Reporting**
* Design, develop, test and maintain Power BI dashboards, executive scorecards and recurring leadership reports.
* Create scalable reporting frameworks, reusable data models and standardized visualization components.
* Automate reporting workflows to reduce manual effort and improve timeliness, consistency and usability.
* Apply effective information design and data storytelling principles to produce executive\-ready outputs.
* Document data sources, logic, calculations, refresh processes and user guidance.
* Build efficiencies, automation and standardization of data workflows
* Develop and maintain collaboration tools and portals to facilitate seamless and efficient operations.
* Provide baselines, targets and measure progress to goals


**Executive Insights \& Analytics**
* Analyze Markets, revenue, sales, pipeline, pursuits, growth and operational performance data.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities, exceptions and key performance drivers.
* Translate complex analysis into concise business narratives, visuals and recommendations for leadership decision\-making.
* Support performance diagnostics, planning, forecasting and leadership review cycles.
* Combine business context with data findings to develop actionable, easy\-to\-consume insights.


**Data Management, Governance \& Innovation**
* Partner with data owners and stakeholders to validate data quality, definitions and reporting logic.
* Support KPI standardization, reporting governance, access controls and consistency across executive deliverables.
* Investigate data issues, perform root\-cause analysis and coordinate resolution with relevant teams.
* Leverage EY Global Analytics tools, Power Platform capabilities and appropriate AI\-enabled tools to enhance reporting and insight generation.
* Identify opportunities for self\-service analytics, workflow efficiency and continuous improvement.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Advanced Power BI development skills, including DAX, Power Query, data modelling, visualization and dashboard performance optimization.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to connect data to business context.
* Good knowledge of EY reporting, Markets data and Global Analytics tools.
* Understanding of revenue, sales, pipeline, pursuits, growth and performance metrics.
* Executive data storytelling, presentation and business writing capability.
* Strong stakeholder management, requirements gathering and communication skills.
* High attention to detail and a strong focus on data accuracy and quality.
* Advanced Excel skills; exposure to MS365 Power Platform, Co\-pilot or related analytics technologies is beneficial.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* 12\+ years of work experience
* Exposure to Big 4 or leading consulting firms is a plus
* Relevant experience in business intelligence, analytics, executive reporting, data visualization or dashboard development at a level appropriate for a Supervising Associate role.
* Demonstrated experience delivering Power BI solutions and leadership\-facing reporting products.
* Experience with EY reporting, Markets data, Global Analytics or a comparable professional services reporting environment is preferred.
* Bachelor’s/ Master’s degree in analytics, information systems, business, statistics, engineering or a related discipline.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: GDS Cyber - DPP - Staff - AI Data Protection Engineering
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI Data Protection Field Engineer**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI\-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI\-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. The role is designed for professionals with early\-career to mid\-career experience who enjoy solving real client problems in delivery settings and building technical depth in modern data protection. The internal role design emphasizes deployment, model/platform integration, testing, and troubleshooting, while comparable market roles emphasize customer\-facing engineering, rapid iteration, and production\-grade solution delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Configure, deploy, and support AI\-enabled data protection capabilities across client environments, including data discovery, classification, DLP\-aligned controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and information rights management patterns.
* Integrate data protection platforms with AI models, copilots, and enterprise workflows to help clients protect sensitive information used in prompts, retrieval sources, generated outputs, and broader AI use cases.
* Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root\-cause analysis, and stabilization support.
* Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof\-of\-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.
* Contribute to reusable playbooks, deployment guides, code snippets, engineering templates, and configuration standards that improve repeatability across engagements. Reusable accelerators and reference implementations are a common requirement in comparable AI engineering roles.
* Work with cross\-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Up to 5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: data protection, DLP, information protection, data discovery/classification, security engineering, cloud security, or related cybersecurity engineering domains.
* Working knowledge of data protection fundamentals, including data discovery and classification, DLP concepts, PKI \& KMS, and information rights management.
* Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI\-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.
* Experience with at least some of the following tools/platforms: Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, VS Code with AI extensions, Claude Enterprise, Gemini Enterprise, Cyera, Varonis, Sentra, CrowdStrike Falcon DSPM, Wiz DSPM, Microsoft Purview, Python, TensorFlow.
* Strong troubleshooting mindset, structured communication, and comfort working in client\-facing delivery environments. Field engineering patterns from Microsoft and AI FDE patterns from the market both strongly emphasize technical depth plus customer communication.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview, DSPM, CASB, sensitivity labeling, data lineage, encryption, or privacy engineering.
* Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

* Typical work environment
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

title: CDP Engineer
description:
**Responsibilities**
* Configure and maintain CDP data models, audience/segment definitions, and identity resolution.
* Build and maintain CDP integrations with Databricks/Delta Lake (zero\-copy access patterns).
* Design and maintain event streaming integration using AWS MSK (Kafka), including external publishing.
* Build, configure, and maintain destination connectors to Adobe Campaign Classic (email), Airship (push), and Infobip (SMS).
* Build and support journeys/orchestration logic, including governance and suppression across overlapping member experiences.
* Support integration work for experimentation/personalization layers (e.g., Optimizely, Bloomreach) consuming CDP\-supplied segmentation.
* Build ingestion pipelines for engagement feedback loops (delivery/engagement events flowing back into Databricks).
* Scope and deliver platform enhancements as new use cases, channels, audiences, or business requirements emerge.
* Partner with product/marketing stakeholders to translate business requirements into CDP configuration and logic.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve platform issues raised by business/marketing stakeholders (e.g., segment/audience errors, sync failures, journey/campaign delivery issues, data discrepancies).
* Perform root\-cause analysis on production issues and implement fixes or workarounds.
* Monitor platform health (sync jobs, journey runs, data freshness, audience counts) and proactively flag/address problems.
* Maintain documentation for platform configuration, data flows, API contracts, and known issues/resolutions.
* Participate in vendor working sessions to define technical requirements and surface product gaps.


**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years working directly in/on a CDP or similar MarTech data platform (configuration, activation, and support)
* Hands\-on experience with audience/segment building, identity resolution, and journey/orchestration tooling
* Strong Databricks and Delta Lake experience (Unity Catalog, data\-sharing connectivity)
* AWS experience, particularly MSK/Kafka.
* REST API integration experience with marketing execution platforms (ESP, push, SMS providers)
* Adobe Campaign Classic experience \- hands\-on with workflows, campaign/journey setup, and API\-based integration
* API\-first, composable architecture / connector\-based integration experience
* Experience implementing/maintaining a CDP Web SDK or similar client\-side event tracking SDK (JavaScript) for behavioral/event data capture
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills; comfortable being a hands\-on point of contact for business\-reported issues
* Strong technical skills


 Support CDP (Customer Data Platform) as part of the Personalization Program covering platform configuration, audience/segmentation build, journey/orchestration support, integrations, enhancements, and ongoing production support. This is a broad CDP role, not limited to integration work, it includes building and maintaining segments, campaigns/journeys, governance and suppression logic, and troubleshooting issues across the platform end\-to\-end.

title: Data Quality Engineering Lead
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for an experienced Data Quality Engineering Lead to ensure the master data content quality and develop systems that continue to improve the quality of the data content. This role requires the ability to define and govern quality strategy to better serve our customers. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between engineering and quality, embedding testing excellence throughout the software development lifecycle.
   

  

 This is a full\-time position and reports directly to the VP, Engineering.
   

  

***Preferred Location***
 Qualified candidates should be based in or near Kochi and able to work from our Kochi office as part of a hybrid schedule.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
**Test Automation Architecture**
* Design, implement and maintain scalable, maintainable data quality automation
* Implement test reporting and analytics solutions, or custom dashboards to surface quality insights


**Cloud, DevOps \& CI/CD Integration**
* Utilize AWS services relevant to quality engineering, including CodePipeline, CodeBuild, ECS, Lambda, S3, and CloudWatch Synthetics
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, BitBucket pipelines, or AWS CodePipeline


**Leadership \& Quality Strategy**
* Define and govern a quality strategy across multiple product teams, including test standards, tooling selection, and metrics frameworks
* Lead and mentor QA engineers and SDETs across automated, manual, and exploratory testing disciplines
* Track and present quality KPIs — including defect escape rate, test coverage, MTTR, and automation ROI — to senior stakeholder


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent education and work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 7\+ years of experience in software and quality engineering, with at least 3 years leading data quality engineering
* Proven track record automating and measuring data quality assurance in production environments
* Proficient in SQL
* Proficient in Python or R
* Proficient with Git for source control
* Experience developing QA automation on AWS or equivalent cloud platforms
* Preferred Experience, Knowledge and Skills
* Experience using AI development tools
* Proficient in Apache Spark (pyspark)


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* Experience using AI development tools.
* Proficient in Apache Spark (pyspark)
* Experience with data quality frameworks Great Expectations or Deequ
* Familiarity with Jenkins


**About Dodge Construction Network**
 Dodge Construction Network exists to deliver the comprehensive data and connections the construction industry needs to build thriving communities. Our legacy is deeply rooted in empowering our customers with transformative insights, igniting their journey towards unparalleled business expansion and success. We serve decision\-makers who seek reliable growth and who value relationships built on trust and quality. By combining our proprietary data with cutting\-edge software, we deliver to our customers the essential intelligence needed to excel within their respective landscapes. We propel the construction industry forward by transforming data into tangible guidance, driving unparalleled advancement.
   

  

 Dodge is the catalyst for modern construction.

title: Engineering Lead - AI
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY Job Description**
**Job Title: Engineering Lead – AI**
**Job Rank (must note a single rank only for each job description): Associate Director**
**Function: EY Technology – Enterprise Technology**
**Scope (indicate either “global/cross\-border” or “local/country”):Global**
**Sub Function: EY Technology \| CBS Technology \| Intelligent Automation**
**Reports to (Job Title): Service Delivery Lead: AI \& Automation**
**Job Summary:**
 The Engineering Lead is responsible for hands\-on engineering delivery of enterprise AI/ML/GenAI and automation solutions, coding standards, design patterns, ensuring production\-grade security, scalability, reliability, and supportability. It is not a solution advisory, PoC, or platform administration role. Success is measured by the quality, reliability, scalability, and operability of AI systems in production.
   

  

 Operating as a player–coach, the Engineering Lead works alongside AI Engineers to design and build ML Models, LLM pipelines and agentic workflows, while also setting engineering standards, coaching teams, and ensuring delivery.
   

  

**The ideal candidate will possess:**
* Extensive, hands\-on software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and operating complex systems in production environments.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, business\-relevant outcomes.
* Ability to independently design and code across multiple technical components, while guiding and elevating the work of senior engineers.
* Deep technical expertise across the full stack, including cloud\-native architectures, distributed systems, and data\-intensive platforms.
* Strong command of non\-functional requirements, including reliability, availability, scalability, performance, and cost optimization, and the ability to make sound technology and architecture decisions as systems evolve over time.
* Demonstrated experience delivering production\-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, including:
* LLM\-powered applications and services
* Agentic workflows and orchestration frameworks
* Model integration, evaluation, and lifecycle management
* MLOps / LLMOps pipelines and operational practices
* Proven experience partnering with Data Science and AI Research teams to operationalize models and AI capabilities at enterprise scale.
* Ability to drive the design and delivery of AI\-first architectures, including LLM\-powered services, agentic workflows, orchestration layers, and human\-in\-the\-loop systems.
* Experience building robust data and software foundations that enable advanced analytics, real\-time AI inference, and intelligent decisioning at scale.


**Essential Functions of the Job:**
* Engineering Ownership \& Delivery Accountability
+ Own end\-to\-end technical delivery of AI and GenAI solutions—from design through production and BAU support.
+ Act as the technical authority for the build team, accountable for:
- Code quality and engineering standards
- Security, privacy, and compliance
- Reliability, scalability, performance, and cost
- Operational readiness and supportability

+ Make hard engineering trade\-offs balancing latency, accuracy, cost, reliability, and scale.
+ Own production systems post go\-live, including incident analysis, performance tuning, and architectural evolution.


* Hands\-on GenAI \& AI Systems Engineering
* 
+ Collaborate with solution architecture on design and own build production\-grade GenAI systems, including:
- Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
- Agentic workflows and tool\-based orchestration
- Prompt pipelines, routing, and integration layers
- Human\-in\-the\-loop and safety guardrails

+ Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with AI Engineers and Data Scientists to:
- Productionize models and LLM pipelines
- Implement evaluation, monitoring, and observability
- Optimize inference cost, performance, and reliability

+ Ensure experimental AI capabilities are engineered into real systems, not isolated prototypes.


* Architecture \& Engineering Standards
+ Define and enforce reference architectures and engineering standards for AI and GenAI systems.
+ Drive consistent adoption of:
- Clean and modular architecture patterns
- Reusable components and shared frameworks
- CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud\-native practices

+ Partner with architecture, platform, security, and data teams while retaining final accountability for build quality.


* AI Platform Engineering \& MLOps / LLMOps
+ Build and evolve AI platforms that support:
- Model lifecycle management
- LLMOps / MLOps pipelines
- Evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection
- Secure access, auditability, and governance

+ Ensure AI systems meet enterprise non\-functional requirements over time, not just at launch.


* Team Leadership \& Capability Building
+ Lead and grow a team of senior engineers within the AI \& Automation build function.
+ Coach engineers on:
- Backend and distributed systems engineering
- GenAI application design and implementation
- Writing maintainable, testable, production\-quality code

+ Set a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, rigor, and continuous improvement.
+ Support hiring and skills development aligned to future AI engineering needs.


* Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration
+ Partner closely with:
- AI/ML Engineering and Data Science teams
- Platform, security, and operations teams
- Architecture and governance forums

+ Translate business and functional requirements into robust technical designs.
+ Act as a senior technical voice in design authorities and delivery governance.


**Engineering Expectations (Non Negotiable)**
* Has built and operated complex, distributed backend systems in production.
* Comfortable debugging production incidents involving AI/LLM pipelines.
* Writes, reviews, and maintains production\-quality code, not just prototypes.
* Understands failure modes of AI systems and designs for resilience.
* Takes ownership for systems after go\-live, including reliability and cost optimization.


**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:**
 This role is critical to ensuring the enterprise’s AI ambition translates into
 **real, reliable, and scalable systems** 
 —not just innovation theater. You will define how AI is built, shipped, and operated across the organization.
   

  

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**
**Core Engineering Skills**
* Strong hands\-on experience in Python, Java, C\#, or similar backend languages.
* Proven experience building API\-driven, cloud\-native systems.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, scalability, and reliability patterns.


**GenAI / AI Engineering (Essential)**
* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications, including:
+ RAG pipelines
+ Agentic or tool\-augmented workflows
+ Prompt orchestration and integration layers

* Experience with:
+ Vector databases and embeddings
+ LLM evaluation, observability, and monitoring
+ Guardrails, safety, and cost controls

* Experience operationalizing AI models at scale in enterprise environments.


**Nice to Have (Not Core Identity)**
* Experience integrating AI services into enterprise automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, ServiceNow).
* Familiarity with Azure AI services and data platforms.


**Detailed Responsibilities:**
* Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement automation solutions using Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and ServiceNow. Create custom workflows, forms, and applications to automate business processes and enhance user experience.
* Integration Management: Integrate Microsoft and ServiceNow platforms with other enterprise applications using APIs, web services, and middleware. Ensure seamless data flow between systems and maintain data integrity across integrated applications.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing of automation solutions to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with business requirements. Implement best practices for code quality, documentation, and version control.
* Observability and Maintenance: Monitor the performance of automation solutions and troubleshoot issues as they arise. Perform regular maintenance and updates to ensure optimal functionality and security of automation applications.
* Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for automation solutions, including design specifications, user guides, and technical manuals. Document processes, workflows, and integration points for future reference and knowledge transfer.
* User Training and Support: Provide training and support to end\-users and team members on automation tools and processes.Develop training materials and conduct workshops to facilitate user adoption of automation solutions.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, project managers, and IT staff, to ensure alignment on automation initiatives. Engage with stakeholders to gather feedback and make necessary adjustments to automation solutions.
* Performance Metrics and Reporting: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of automation solutions. Generate reports and dashboards to communicate the impact of automation on business processes and operational efficiency.
* Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in automation, AI, and relevant technologies.Identify areas for continuous improvement and propose enhancements to existing automation solutions.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure that automation solutions adhere to organizational policies, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Participate in risk assessments and audits related to automation initiatives.
* Innovation and Research: Explore and evaluate new technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance automation capabilities. Conduct research on industry best practices and competitor strategies to inform decision\-making and innovation.
* Change Management: Analyze the impact of automation on organizational processes and culture, making recommendations for change management strategies. Assist in developing communication plans to inform stakeholders about automation initiatives and their benefits.


**Other Requirements:**
* Familiarity with Python practices and tools.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and influence
* Strong leadership and conflict resolution capability
* Leading virtual teams


**Job Requirements:**
**Education:**
* A degree in Computer Science / Engineering or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience


**Experience:**
* 10\+ years in a Global IT environment working with multiple disciplines to deliver projects in line with customer needs
* 3\+ Years Global delivery or transformation preferably in large scale infrastructure programs
* 3\+ Years in a global operations environment


**Certification Requirements:**
* Relevant certifications in MS Power Platform and ServiceNow RPA
* Python Certification
* Azure AI Services
* Azure Data Services


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Tech S and T-Manager- Disaster Recovery- DB-ISR-Manager-GDSF02

title: Engineering Systems Support Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 The role focuses on supporting Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems and related engineering applications, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and efficient operation across integrated business platforms. Responsibilities include application support, data analysis, SQL reporting, troubleshooting, documentation, process improvement, and collaboration with engineering, IT, and business stakeholders.
   

  

 The analyst will work closely with design engineers, product development teams, IT professionals, and third\-party vendors to resolve technical issues, improve system performance, and support engineering processes. Candidates should enjoy problem solving, working with data, learning new technologies, and supporting enterprise applications within an engineering and manufacturing environment. As experience grows, the role will progress toward ownership of engineering systems, business processes, and system improvement initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical support for PLM systems and associated engineering applications across multiple business units and engineering disciplines.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application, system, and data\-related issues while ensuring minimal disruption to engineering operations.
* Write, maintain, and execute SQL queries to support reporting, data validation, data reconciliation, and engineering business processes.
* Monitor and maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across PLM and integrated enterprise systems.
* Support engineering teams in the effective use of engineering systems, business applications, and product data management processes.
* Assist in analysing engineering and product data to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and third\-party vendors to gather requirements, support projects, and resolve technical issues.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, testing activities, and implementation of process improvements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of reports, dashboards, validation tools, and business intelligence outputs that support engineering operations.
* Assist with administration and routine maintenance activities for Windows Server environments supporting engineering applications.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation, user guides, process documentation, test reports, release notes, and technical specifications.
* Support user training activities and assist in developing subject matter expertise within engineering and business teams.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and support activities, proactively driving issues through resolution while communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, and engineering governance requirements.
* The successful candidate will work under guidance of Senior Analyst, who will oversee their workload and scheduling.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in information systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related subject is preferred.
* 1\-3 years of experience supporting business applications, enterprise systems, engineering systems, or technical software platforms, with hands\-on experience using SQL for reporting, data analysis, data validation, and troubleshooting data\-related issues.
* Understanding of relational database concepts, data structures, and relationships between enterprise systems.
* Exposure to enterprise platforms such as PLM, ERP, Product Data Management (PDM), Document Management, CAD, or similar engineering systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, VB.NET, ASP.NET, Visual Studio, JSON, XML, XSLT, ODBC databases, and Web Services is advantageous.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server environments, application hosting platforms, and system administration concepts.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate and resolve technical and data\-related issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, business, and IT teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows curiosity and initiative by continuously learning new systems, technologies, and business processes.
* Communicates proactively, builds positive working relationships, and effectively collaborates with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* Produces accurate, well\-documented, and maintainable solutions while maintaining a high standard of quality.
* Approaches challenges with professionalism, persistence, and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Experience within an engineering, manufacturing, industrial, or operational environment is desirable.


**About Us**
 Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
   

  

**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
 Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
   

  

**Global Family**
 We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**Purposeful Innovation**
 Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
   

  

**Service Above All**
 This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**The Role** 




 As a Platform Engineer in the Data \& Analytics team, you’ll sit at the vital intersection between software engineering and infrastructure. Your mission is to ensurethat the systemswe build are not only functional, but also resilient, observable, performant, and production ready.
 



 You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, and the central infrastructure team to design and support the environments, tooling, and operational practicesthat power our data platform.From CI/CD pipelines to database performance tuning, observability, and scaling strategy — you’ll be the expert who helps us build mechanical sympathy between our code and the systems it runs on.
 



 This is a hands\-on, enablingrole ideal for someone who loves helpingteams ship great software safelyand reliably.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and evolve the CI/CD pipelines for the Data Platform, supporting fast, safe, and repeatable deployments.
* Enhance observability across services, pipelines, and data flows, supporting logs, metrics, tracing, and alerts.
* Monitor and optimize databaseperformance, availability, and access patterns.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teamsto ensure HA, disaster recovery, and scaling strategies are in place and well understood.
* Partner with engineers to define best practices for environment management, secrets, configuration, and infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Support the team in diagnosing and resolving production issues and in building systemsthat are easier to debug and maintain.
* Identify and reduce operational friction, creating tools or automations where needed to improve reliability and developer velocity.



  





  





 Essential Criteria
 



  




* Strong experience working with CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and application performance tooling.
* Practical knowledge of observability stacks— including metrics,logs, dashboards, and alerting.
* Hands\-on experience with databases(e.g. PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or cloud\-native DBs), including monitoring and tuning.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (preferably AWS), containerization, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation).
* A collaborative mindset, able to work across engineering and infrastructure teamsto solve shared problems.
* Passion for enabling others,improving developer experience, and building reliablesystems.



  





  





 Desirable Criteria
 


* Experience supporting data pipelines, analytics platforms, or distributed systems at scale.
* Familiarity with data management frameworks (e.g. AWS Glue, Temporal) and performance profiling in data\-intensive environments.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**ET SIC Reporting Analyst**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. Fueled by a US$1\.5\+B investment in technology and innovation, EY is primed to guide clients in their efforts to drive sustainable growth, create new value, and build new and better ways of working. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The role**
 SIC Reporting Analyst is responsible for supporting vulnerability management reporting for ET (excluding Platform Mgmt) and providing accurate, timely and actionable compliance insights.
   

  

 This position requires close collaboration with global teams across ET, Infosec and business functions to align reporting with the broader risk frameworks. The analyst will be responsible for monitoring progress against vulnerability mgmt goals, validating that vulnerabilities are remediated or approved plans are recorded within defined SLA targets, and providing compliance status through regular assessments, on\-going leadership reviews and real\-time dashboards.
   

  

 As part of the role, the individual will assess existing reporting processes, refine them as business needs change, and work closely with Infosec and other stakeholders to strengthen data quality, reporting controls and governance models within Enterprise Technology. The ideal candidate brings relevant experience in IT risk reporting, governance and analytics, contributing to EY’s overall risk management plan.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As the SIC Reporting Analyst, the key responsibilities would include:
   

  

* Prepare and maintain Global Vulnerability mgmt compliance reports for all in\-scope IT functions within Enterprise Technology (excluding Platform Mgmt), including GRAC reporting for in\-scope I\&O functions.
* Consolidate vulnerability, remediation and exception data from approved sources; validate completeness and accuracy before reports are published.
* Monitor compliance within agreed SLA’s as established by Infosec, tracking remediation progress, overdue items and adherence to security policies.
* Prepare weekly / monthly SIC updates and leadership review materials to provide clear insights into vulnerability mgmt performance.
* Maintain reporting definitions, templates, calculation logic and documented controls to enable consistent and repeatable reporting.
* Collaborate with Infosec and I\&O product managers to understand reporting requirements, source\-data changes and future product road maps.
* Maintain end\-to\-end reporting views for vulnerabilities across ET (excluding Platform Management), including remediation plans, exceptions, approvals and closure status.
* Work closely with Infosec and stakeholders within ET to provide reporting support for Critical Vulnerability Response Plan (CVRP) exercises.
* Produce vulnerability management dashboards, scorecards, trend analysis and actionable insights for operational and leadership reviews.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and act as a reporting conduit between Infosec, Product/Application, Engineering, Operations \& Management; follow up on data gaps and unresolved ownership issues.
* Provide segmented reporting and follow\-up views for Data Restricted Countries (DRCS) and Local Support teams (excluding Platform Management).
* Identify, assess and highlight risk trends, ageing, recurring issues and priority remediation areas for I\&O (excluding Platform Mgmt).
* Compliance Management: Support reporting that demonstrates whether in\-scope portfolios for I\&O adhere to GCoC recommended policies, compliances, regulations and standards.
* Identify opportunities to automate and standardize data preparation, validation, dashboard refresh and recurring report distribution.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experienced in managing key Stakeholder relationships, including Senior Management.
* Good understanding of Industry GRAC, vulnerability mgmt standards and compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of other Risk domains such as Operations Risk Management, IT Security and Cyber Risks, with the ability to interpret and report these risks.
* Good working knowledge of IT Operations, IT practices and operational reporting.
* Can work with minimum direction and deliver timely, accurate and high\-quality results.
* High integrity; dedicated to excellence; highly attentive to details; flexible. Possesses sound Project Management and coordination skills.
* Self\-motivated, with ability to work independently, as well as with other stakeholders in a collaborative manner.
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Experience in working with multiple stakeholders at different levels of the organization, including senior management.
* Excellent communication skills, especially related to facilitation, documentation and reporting
* Coordination skills and the ability to leverage support from other parts of the organization.
* Ability to work with cross\-functional stakeholders and senior leadership


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
**Education:**
* Bachelor or Master’s degree in Information Technology / Engineering


**Experience:**
* 6 \- 9\+ years of relevant experience in IT risk, vulnerability management, compliance reporting, data analytics or Service Delivery


**What We Look For**
* Thought leadership
* Strategic Thinking
* Automation \& standardization
* Relationship Management
* Interpersonal \& Influencing skills
* Good communication skills
* Data\-driven decision making


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: O9 Engineer
description:
Experience \- 5 plus years
   

  

 We are hiring an O9 Solutions Engineer to support and evolve the O9 platform for one of the largest retailers in the United States. O9 is the system of record for demand forecasting, supply planning, and allocation decisions across our brands, regions, and channels. This role owns the day\-to\-day health of the platform — triaging and resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity between O9 and upstream/downstream systems such as Oracle EBS, and partnering with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and Merchandising teams to keep the platform reliable, accurate, and easy to use across a global user base (US, UK, EMEA, and APAC).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Serve as a primary point of support for O9 Supply Planning and Demand Planning modules, triaging incidents end\-to\-end from intake through root\-cause and resolution.
* Investigate and resolve data integrity issues between O9 and connected systems (Oracle EBS, RMA/returns feeds, buy\-plan and sourcing extracts), including mismatched quantities, missing style\-colors, and forecast data not flowing between planning modules.
* Diagnose and fix planning logic issues — unmet demand, incorrect season codes, planned orders not grouping correctly, buy dates shifting unexpectedly, and similar planning\-engine anomalies.
* Manage user access and provisioning (new hires, role changes, regional access, ownership transfers) and drive toward self\-service or bulk\-provisioning workflows to reduce manual ticket volume.
* Own incident and backlog hygiene: track SLAs, prioritize aging tickets, and ensure nothing sits unresolved for months without visibility to stakeholders.
* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and regional business teams (US, UK, China, Japan) to translate business\-reported issues into technical root causes.
* Build and maintain runbooks, root\-cause documentation, and knowledge base articles so common issues can be resolved consistently — not just by institutional memory.
* Support configuration changes, workflow updates, and enhancements within O9 as the retailer's planning processes evolve (new brands, new seasons, new regions).
* Participate in O9 platform upgrades, testing cycles, and post\-implementation review (PIR) processes for major changes.
* Escalate to and collaborate with O9 Solutions' vendor support team on platform\-level defects that require vendor engineering involvement.
* Skillset
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting or implementing O9\.
* Solid understanding of retail supply chain planning concepts: demand forecasting, supply/buy planning, allocation, assortment, and season/style\-color management.
* Experience integrating planning systems with ERP platforms, ideally Oracle EBS, including familiarity with common data reconciliation issues between planning and execution systems.
* Strong troubleshooting skills — comfortable reading data flows end\-to\-end to isolate whether an issue originates in source data, integration, or planning logic.
* Experience with incident management tools (ServiceNow or similar) and a track record of managing ticket queues, SLAs, and prioritization in a production support environment.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data investigation and validation.
* Excellent written communication skills — you'll be documenting root causes and explaining technical issues to non\-technical business stakeholders across time zones.
* Comfortable working with global, cross\-regional teams (US, EMEA, APAC) and adjusting communication style accordingly.

title: Revenue Operations Reporting Specialist
description:
Dodge Construction Network (Dodge) is looking for a Reporting Specialist to own the build and ongoing maintenance of our GTM reporting. This is a focused, execution\-oriented role: the Specialist produces and maintains reports and dashboards in Salesforce (SFDC) and other sources to defined specifications, keeps the existing reporting library accurate and current, and works from a structured request queue.
   

  

 The role is designed to be delivered by an offshore resource working in close, documented coordination with our onshore Revenue Operations team. The Salesforce Reporting Specialist does the hands\-on building, refreshing, and quality\-checking of the reports.
   

  

 This is a full\-time role with overall accountability to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations \& Analytics.
   

  

***Preferred Location and Expected Work Hours***
 This role is based in Kochi, India. Given the need for real\-time collaboration with Dodge's US\-based GTM team, candidates should be comfortable working hours that overlap with US time zones, generally 12:00\-8:00 PM IST.
   

  

***Travel Requirements***
 Expected travel is less than 5% of the time but may occasionally be required for team meetings.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Build new Salesforce reports, custom report types, and dashboards to written specifications provided by the onshore Revenue Operations team
* Maintain, update, and troubleshoot the existing library of Salesforce reports and dashboards, keeping filters, groupings, and data sources accurate and current
* Build and refresh Business Intelligence dashboards and their underlying data extracts to defined specifications
* Perform routine quality assurance on reports and dashboards—verifying accuracy, checking for broken filters or stale data, and confirming figures reconcile to source
* Manage the report and dashboard catalog, including folder structure, naming conventions, and sharing and visibility settings
* Execute and monitor scheduled report refreshes and recurring distributions, confirming successful delivery
* Document report logic, field definitions, and change history so that reporting is transparent and reproducible
* Work a structured request/ticket queue, delivering standard reporting changes within agreed service\-level timeframes
* Log and escalate data discrepancies and suspected upstream data issues to the onshore team for root\-cause resolution
* Regression\-test reports and dashboards following Salesforce releases, additional Dodge hiring and role changes, or configuration changes, and flag anything that breaks


***Education Requirement***
 Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical field, and/or equivalent work experience.
   

  

**Required Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* 2\+ years building and maintaining reports and dashboards in Salesforce
* Proficiency with the Salesforce report builder, custom report types, and dashboards
* Experience building or maintaining dashboards in Tableau, QuickSight or other comparable Business Intelligence tool
* Strong Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables
* Excellent written English and clear, asynchronous communication for documented coordination across time zones
* Highly detail\-oriented, with comfort working from specifications, queues, and service\-level expectations
* Reliable availability to overlap with United States Eastern Time business hours


**Preferred Experience, Knowledge And Skills**
* Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM\-201\) or equivalent
* Exposure to Salesforce CPQ reporting
* Familiarity with SQL or other data\-preparation tools
* Prior experience working as part of a distributed or offshore delivery team
